posts.quote:
The fog came in
and the world got small.
Just me, the trees,
and the sound of my steps.

The first snow
came in the night.
The trail is the same.
Everything else is new.

Still water,
still mind.
Sit a while
before you turn back.

Every peak looks impossible
from the parking lot.
Then you start walking.

The desert keeps time
in stone, not hours.
Out here,
nobody is in a hurry.

Cold air, warm coffee,
and a mountain
that doesn't mind
how long you stare.

Shorter days.
Earlier starts.
The same happy walk home.
